parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button located on the top of the toilet tank, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic lid that covers the water tank of the toilet.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but typically remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the toilet seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a hygienic cover and aesthetic finish to the toilet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured plastic ring that provides a comfortable sitting surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user during use and can be lifted for cleaning or other purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the bowl.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water, supports the seat, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
